name: Stay At Home Moms
overview: Scripture highlights the vital role of stay-at-home moms in nurturing and guiding their children and families according to God’s design. Proverbs 22:6 emphasizes the importance of training children in the way they should go, while Titus 2:3-5 instructs women to be wise, loving, and keepers at home, fostering holiness and obedience to their husbands. This calling is supported by a lifestyle marked by prayer and trust in God, as encouraged in Philippians 4:6, ensuring that the home remains a place where God’s word is honored and upheld.
